api: mad_stream_init; mad_stream_buffer(local bytes + MAD_BUFFER_GUARD zero bytes); mad_frame_decode until MAD_ERROR_BUFLEN; mad_synth_frame; MAD_RECOVERABLE errors counted
coverage: LLVM source coverage of libmad built from the pinned release with CMake (static, FPM_64BIT, OPT_SPEED defaults; no assembly)
input_padding: The harness copies the input and appends exactly MAD_BUFFER_GUARD (8) zero bytes, because mad_header_decode in src/frame.c returns MAD_ERROR_BUFLEN unless 8 bytes follow a frame. Inputs are capped at 1 MiB. The zero guard yields one MAD_ERROR_LOSTSYNC at offset input_bytes; only that error marks end of input. Every other MAD_RECOVERABLE error is counted in recoverable_errors, unrecoverable errors fail the parse, and consumed_bytes shows where decoding stopped.
coverage_limit: Untagged MPEG Layer III only; two valid CBR controls (MPEG-1 44.1 kHz mono, MPEG-2 22.05 kHz stereo) do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II, MPEG-2.5 or ID3 handling. libmad is also linked by the SoX path counted under mp3_id3v2/c; this is its own plain-frame path. Fixed-point output is not compared sample by sample with another decoder.
